title: Ribasim-coupled surface-water application profile admission
objective: Admit one narrow application profile in which real Ribasim is sole owner of the represented surface-water store, SWAP retains the signed extended drainage/infiltration process, and the coupling layer enforces accepted-state external heads, feasibility/recomposition and exactly-once transfer semantics.

admitted_profile_candidate.name: EXTERNAL_RIBASIM_SURFACE_WATER_V1
admitted_profile_candidate.external_head_source: accepted Ribasim surface-water level supplied explicitly per drainage level

hard_invariants: SWAP_FIXED_WEIR_STATE_OWNER XOR EXTERNAL_RIBASIM_STATE_OWNER for the same physical store.
External Ribasim profile may not allocate or commit SWST-equivalent surface-water storage inside SWAP.
Each active extended signed exchange level requires one finite accepted external surface-water head.
Positive drainage and negative infiltration remain signed SWAP process responses and are booked exactly once.
If Ribasim availability changes a requested negative transfer, the coupled window is recomposed from accepted origins; accept-with-clip is forbidden.
Rejected trials cannot mutate accepted SWAP state, accepted Ribasim state, or management-policy memory.
Q1H storage representation epsilon is frozen at 1e-6 m for this admission candidate.
Exact nonlinear SWQHR1 numerical parity is outside this application profile.
gates: A: replay Q4A source-bound stateless process candidate on current canonical.
B: replay Q4B transactional signed runtime binding on current canonical.
C: implement and qualify fail-closed external-Ribasim owner profile validation in src/adapter/mod_ribasim_surface_water_profile.f90.
D: qualify Q1H epsilon=1e-6 geometry contract and provenance binding.
E: end-to-end accepted-head, signed-transfer, retry/restart and mass composition without internal SWAP surface-water state.
nonclaims: No production admission until all gates pass on current canonical-derived branch.

accepted_head_view_requires: one finite external head per configured drainage-response level
profile_validator.owner_xor: internal_swap_fixed_weir_state_active must be false when external_ribasim_active is true
profile_validator.excluded: exact nonlinear SWQHR1 parity and accept-with-clip
